geraeteText: All devices from all racks, including position, network data, ports and notes. Opens directly in Excel or LibreOffice.
verbindungenText: All port connections with source, target and status — which device port is connected to what.
sicherungText: Racks, locations, devices, individual ports and connections in one file. Device images are included as paths only.
importText: Read a downloaded JSON backup to move to another installation or restore an earlier state. Device images are not in the file: paths without an existing image are discarded.
ergaenzenText: Add the racks from the file to the existing content.
ersetzenText: The current content is deleted first.
keinInhalt: The file contains no importable racks or locations.
warnung: Replace deletes the current content first.
entfaellt: This removes {racks}, {standorte}{geraete} and {verbindungen}, including uploaded device images.
pdfText: Opens the Racks page with the selected rack and the print dialog. Choose Save as PDF there.
backupHinweis: Separately, the backup container backs up the database and device images every night.
falschesFormat: This is not a RackView backup.
name: Name
